# T2OS — AI-Powered Business OS by T2 Digital
> منصة بناء وتشغيل الأعمال بالذكاء الاصطناعي — تحت إدارة T2 Digital (T2 Digital Solutions for Business Development)

Slogan (AR): منصة بناء وتشغيل الأعمال بالذكاء الاصطناعي — تحت إدارة T2 Digital
Slogan (EN): AI-Powered Business OS by T2 Digital

## Core Modules
- T2OS Core (Jarvis / الظل): Voice & text AI executive orchestrator with 5 specialist swarm agents and cloud memory.
- T2OS Apps: Instant multi-tenant PWA storefronts (e-commerce + ERP/POS) and service booking platforms with isolated Firestore databases.
- T2OS Studio: AI content strategy, visual & video generation, and multi-platform scheduling across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Telegram, X, LinkedIn, and Snapchat.
- T2OS Agent: 24/7 WhatsApp & social sales/support agent connected directly to each brand's live catalog and bookings.
